/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 34-year-old man comes to the physician for a routine health maintenance examination required for his occupation as a school bus driver. He feels well and healthy. Upon questioning, he reports that he has smoked 2 joints of marijuana every night after work for the past year for recreational purposes. He typically smokes 5 joints or more on weekends. Which of the following responses by the physician is the most appropriate?

Options:
A. """Let me know when you are ready to stop smoking marijuana. We can talk about specific strategies to help you quit at that time."""
B. """Have you ever experienced a situation in which you wished you smoked less marijuana?"""
C. """When did you start being dependent on marijuana consumption?"""
D. """We have a great program to help patients with substance use disorder issues. Let me give you more information about specific details."""
E. """You should stop smoking marijuana because it is not good for your health."""

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question concerns marijuana use and appropriate physician counseling for substance use, which falls within the scope of substance use disorders."}
